name: Plan VFX
description: Plans visual effects enhancements for specific clips.

inputs.name: creative_brief
inputs.description: The captain's creative direction as markdown, injected by the runner from the project's creative_brief path. Empty when the project declares none.

inputs.name: clip_catalog
inputs.description: State input: clip_catalog. Read for the clip_id the rest of this step's context uses; `view:picture` keys its rows by it. Optional because the view names the vision pass's own id and says so when no clip list is routed.

inputs.name: timeline_notes
inputs.description: The captain's own notes typed onto the built timeline in DaVinci Resolve, routed to this step because this step owns the decision each note is about. Injected by the runner from <project>/marker_feedback/ and absent when there are none. See library/tools/marker_routing.py.

outputs.name: enhancement_spec
outputs.description: State output: enhancement_spec. `visual_effects` is the resolved plan; `planning_basis` says why it is the length it is, so an empty plan the planner chose is distinguishable from one whose every entry was dropped. See library/tools/vfx_plan_basis.py.

outputs.name: vfx_candidates_legend
outputs.description: Bridge output: what the derived vfx_candidates_toon columns mean, carried as DATA because handoff.md is frozen - the route step 4.02 takes for CUTS_LEGEND. Declared here because the bridge emits it on every run and validate_step_output otherwise reports it as an unexpected extra field.

llm_outputs.name: vfx_creative
llm_outputs.description: Visual effects, at most one per block. Each: target_block_position, effect_type, params, rationale. Drift motion on a static hold (`slow_zoom_in` / `slow_zoom_out`) applies ONLY where the entry states a per-shot rationale saying why that shot wants it - an entry with a missing or blank rationale gets no motion and is dropped as `no_stated_reason` (captain's ruling 2026-09-08; motion is never a blanket rule or a default).
